purpose: Teach: 立ち入り/来客/注釈/痕跡/痕/に当たる/成っ/時として

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 立ち入り禁止区域、警告、徹底しろ。
lines.en: Enforce strict warnings on restricted areas. No exceptions.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Each phrase a separate command. Cold and measured. No room for misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来客への案内、明確に行います。
lines.en: Understood. I'll make the visitor briefings crystal clear.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Professional tempo. Slight pause before each commitment—he's checking himself against the standard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書の注釈、細かく確認しろ。
lines.en: Check the contract annotations closely. Every detail.
lines.style: Deliberate weight on each word. Not rushed. The tone of someone who knows oversights become liabilities.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。過去の不正の痕跡、念入りに調査します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll investigate any traces of past irregularities thoroughly.
lines.style: Steady assurance. He leans into the word 'thoroughly'—this matters. No shortcuts in his delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: システムに残る痕、消去手順、整えろ。
lines.en: Establish clear procedures for removing system records. Immediately.
lines.style: Final-sounding. The clip of someone closing a file. Precise diction. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。再発予防に当たる施策、まとめます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll compile preventative measures to stop this from happening again.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. He's absorbed the weight of what's being asked. Measured breathing. Commits without drama.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績、好調に成っているな。
lines.style: Observation more than approval. Slight pause after—he's weighing something. Not quite satisfied, but seeing the improvement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。時として、判断、即決を求められます。
lines.en: Yes. Sometimes I'm called on to make quick decisions.
lines.style: Careful. A small admission beneath the surface. He's testing whether the boss will hear what he's not quite saying.
